text: If 3x - 7 = 11, find the value of 5x + 3.
The sum of three consecutive odd numbers is 75. Find the largest number.
explanation: Let numbers be x, x+2, x+4. 3x+6=75, x=23. Largest = 27.

text: If a - b = 3 and a² - b² = 39, find the value of a + b.
If 2^(x+3) = 64, find x.
The sum of two numbers is 45 and their difference is 11. Find the product of the two numbers.
If the polynomial x² + bx + 12 has roots 3 and 4, find b.
explanation: Sum of roots = -b = 3+4 = 7. So b = -7. Check: product = 12 = 3×4. ✓

The average of 10 numbers is 15. If each number is multiplied by 3, the new average is:
explanation: When each number is multiplied by 3, the average is also multiplied by 3. New average = 15 × 3 = 45.

text: The average of 5 numbers is 42. If one number 35 is replaced by 50, the new average is:
explanation: Original sum = 210. New sum = 210 - 35 + 50 = 225. New average = 225/5 = 45.

text: The average weight of A, B, C is 60 kg. A's weight is 10 kg more than B's and 15 kg more than C's. Find A's weight.
The circumference of a circle is 44 cm. Find its area.
A rectangular park 80m × 60m has a path 5m wide running inside along its boundary. Find the area of the path.
explanation: Outer area = 80×60 = 4800. Inner dimensions = 70×50 = 3500. Path area = 4800-3500 = 1300 sq m.

text: The volume of a sphere is 4851 cm³. Find its radius. (Use π = 22/7)
An equilateral triangle has a side of 12 cm. Find its area.
explanation: Area of equilateral triangle = (√3/4) × a² = (√3/4) × 144 = 36√3 sq cm.

text: A wire bent in the form of a circle of radius 14 cm is re-bent into a square. Find the side of the square.
explanation: Circumference = 2πr = 2 × 22/7 × 14 = 88 cm. Perimeter of square = 88. Side = 88/4 = 22 cm.

text: The ratio of the ages of father and son is 7:2. After 10 years, the ratio will be 9:4. Find the present age of the father.
explanation: Let ages be 7x and 2x. After 10 years: (7x+10)/(2x+10) = 9/4. 28x+40 = 18x+90. 10x = 50. x=5. Father = 35.

text: If 15 men can do a piece of work in 20 days, in how many days can 25 men do the same work?
explanation: Men × Days = constant. 15 × 20 = 25 × d. d = 300/25 = 12 days.

text: Divide Rs. 1870 among A, B, C in the ratio 2:3:6.
In a mixture of 60 litres, the ratio of milk to water is 2:1. How much water must be added to make the ratio 1:2?
explanation: Milk = 40L, Water = 20L. New ratio 1:2: 40/(20+x) = 1/2. 80 = 20+x. x = 60 litres.

text: A marked price of an item is Rs. 800. A shopkeeper allows a discount of 10% and still makes a profit of 20%. Find the cost price.
A man bought 10 eggs for Rs. 40 and sold 8 eggs for Rs. 40. Find his profit percentage.
explanation: CP per egg = 4. SP per egg = 5. Profit = 1 per egg. Profit% = 1/4 × 100 = 25%.

text: A dealer sells a radio at a gain of 20%. Had he sold it for Rs. 100 more, he would have gained 25%. Find the cost price.
If goods are purchased for Rs. 450 and one-third is sold at a loss of 10%, at what gain% should the remaining be sold to get an overall profit of 20%?
explanation: Total SP needed = 450 × 1.2 = 540. One-third CP = 150, sold at 10% loss = 135. Remaining CP = 300, needed SP = 540-135 = 405. Gain% = (405-300)/300 × 100 = 35%.

text: 30% of a number is 150. What is 75% of that number?
If the price of sugar rises by 25%, by what percentage should a family reduce its consumption so that the expenditure remains the same?
explanation: Reduction = (increase/(100+increase)) × 100 = 25/125 × 100 = 20%.

text: Two numbers are respectively 20% and 50% more than a third number. What is the ratio of the two numbers?
explanation: Let third number = 100. First = 120, Second = 150. Ratio = 120:150 = 4:5.

text: A number is first increased by 10% and then decreased by 10%. The net change is:
explanation: 1.1 × 0.9 = 0.99. Net change = 1% decrease. This is the successive percentage formula: -ab/100 = -100/100 = -1%.

text: In an examination, 35% students failed in Maths, 25% failed in English, and 10% failed in both. What percentage passed in both?
explanation: Failed in at least one = 35+25-10 = 50%. Passed in both = 100-50 = 50%.

text: What is the smallest 4-digit number exactly divisible by 12, 15, and 18?
How many prime numbers are there between 50 and 80?
The difference between a two-digit number and the number obtained by interchanging its digits is 27. The difference of the digits is:
explanation: Number = 10a+b. Reversed = 10b+a. Difference = 9(a-b) = 27. a-b = 3.

text: If the sum of two numbers is 55 and their HCF and LCM are 5 and 120 respectively, find the sum of the reciprocals of the numbers.
explanation: HCF × LCM = product of numbers. Product = 5 × 120 = 600. Sum of reciprocals = (a+b)/(a×b) = 55/600 = 11/120.

text: A car travels 240 km at a uniform speed. If the speed had been 20 km/hr more, it would have taken 2 hours less. Find the original speed.
A man walks at 5 km/hr and reaches his office 10 minutes late. If he walks at 6 km/hr, he reaches 10 minutes early. Find the distance to his office.
explanation: Difference in time = 20 min = 1/3 hr. d/5 - d/6 = 1/3. (6d-5d)/30 = 1/3. d/30 = 1/3. d = 10 km.

text: A train 200m long crosses a bridge 300m long in 25 seconds. What is the speed of the train?
explanation: Total distance = 200+300 = 500m. Speed = 500/25 = 20 m/s = 20 × 18/5 = 72 km/hr.

text: Two trains running in the same direction at 60 km/hr and 40 km/hr respectively. The faster train crosses a man in the slower train in 18 seconds. Find the length of the faster train.
explanation: Relative speed = 60-40 = 20 km/hr = 50/9 m/s. Length = speed × time = 50/9 × 18 = 100 m.

text: A boat takes 4 hours to travel 20 km upstream and 2 hours to travel 20 km downstream. Find the speed of the boat in still water.
explanation: Upstream speed = 20/4 = 5 km/hr. Downstream speed = 20/2 = 10 km/hr. Boat speed = (5+10)/2 = 7.5 km/hr.

text: The length and breadth of a room are 15m and 12m. Find the length of the longest rod that can be placed on the floor.
The radius of a cylindrical vessel is 7 cm and height is 10 cm. Find the volume.
explanation: Volume = πr²h = 22/7 × 49 × 10 = 1540 cm³.

text: If 12.5% of a number equals 75, what is 37.5% of that number?
A's salary is 30% more than B's. By what percentage is B's salary less than A's?
explanation: Let B = 100. A = 130. B is less than A by 30/130 × 100 = 23.08%.

text: A number when divided by 6 leaves a remainder 3, and when divided by 8 leaves a remainder 5. What is the remainder when the same number is divided by 24?
explanation: N = 6a+3, N = 8b+5. From first: N is 3,9,15,21,27,33,39,45... From second: N is 5,13,21,29,37,45... Common: 21, 45, 69... 21 mod 24 = 21. 45 mod 24 = 21. Remainder is always 21.

The diagonal of a rectangle is 25 cm and one side is 24 cm. Find the perimeter of the rectangle.
